scope: The listed checks passed for 16 generated editorial pages and a representative local-browser smoke check; this does not certify the full site as WCAG conformant.

browser_keyboard_smoke.skip_link: Shift+Tab reached the skip link; Enter navigated to #main; following Tab reached the main content breadcrumb without a focus trap.

sampled_wcag_aa_contrast.method: Computed foreground/background colors in the local browser; WCAG relative luminance calculation.

measurements.element: status badge text on its pale background

limitations: Automated axe-core results and the sampled contrast checks do not certify WCAG conformance.
Contrast was sampled on representative text and badge colors, not exhaustively measured for every site component or dark theme.
No independent accessibility audit, screen-reader user test, or browser zoom test is claimed.
Interactive disclosure activation was not separately confirmed through browser automation; native HTML details/summary semantics are present on all 16 pages.

axe_core_automated.result: All tested WCAG A/AA/2.1 AA/2.2 AA rules passed; no axe incomplete checks remained after replacing the gradient hero background with a solid theme tint.
axe_core_automated.scope: Automated checks only; does not establish WCAG conformance or replace manual assistive-technology review.
